stem: The countdown until graduation is on and Eli only has 55,225,800 seconds to wait. How many more years of high school does he have left? Round to three significant figures.
explanation: 55,225,800 s × (1 min / 60 s) × (1 h / 60 min) × (1 day / 24 h) × (1 yr / 365 days) = 1.75 years. Each factor cancels the unit before it.

stem: Jace has been bragging that he can bench press 5,900 grams at the gym. It sounds impressive, but you know better. How many pounds is he actually lifting? Round to three significant figures.
explanation: 5,900 g × (1 lb / 453.6 g) = 13.0 lb. Grams cancel, leaving pounds. A pound is about 454 g, so 5,900 g is only about 13 lb.
